_sources._regions: us-socal = Mexico border to Point Conception (34°27'N) incl. Channel Islands = CDFW Southern Groundfish Management Area; us-central = Point Conception to Pigeon Point (37°11'N) = Central GMA; us-norcal = Pigeon Point to the box edge at 38.6°N (Bodega) = southern part of the San Francisco GMA (Point Arena 38°57.5'N). Boundaries chosen so groundfish closures map 1:1 to season regions.
_sources._method: LOW confidence overall: built from well-documented fishery patterns (CDFW species accounts in "California's Living Marine Resources" and Review of Selected California Fisheries/CalCOFI reports; PFMC HMS SAFE descriptions; CDFW CRFS sampling) rather than a per-month catch dataset. No monthly RecFIN/CRFS series was downloaded. Calibrate with RecFIN CTE estimates (https://www.recfin.org) or CPFV logbooks before trusting fine month differences.
_sources.yellowtail: SoCal spring–fall run at the islands and coast; warm years reach Monterey (rare). medium/low
_sources.white-seabass: SoCal spring squid-spawn peak Mar–Jun (note 1-fish limit Mar 15–Jun 15 south of Pt Conception), Monterey/SF summer–fall in recent years. CDFW WSB Enhanced Status Report. low
_sources.calico-bass: Kelp bass are a SoCal species (rare north of Pt Conception); best in warm months. low
_sources.barred-sand-bass: Summer spawning aggregations (Jun–Aug) on sand flats (Huntington Flats, Silver Strand); CDFW barred sand bass ESR. medium
_sources.california-halibut: Spring–summer inshore movement; SF Bay summer fishery. CDFW California halibut ESR. low
_sources.pacific-bluefin: 2012–2025 SoCal sport fishery near year-round offshore, peak May–Oct; occasional central coast. low
_sources.yellowfin-tuna: Warm-water summer/fall visitor, mainly Jul–Oct in SoCal; very variable year to year. low
_sources.dorado: Late summer–early fall on kelp paddies in warm years. low
_sources.striped-marlin: SoCal season Aug–Oct (peak Sep–Oct) off San Diego/Catalina. low
_sources.swordfish: Late summer–fall (harpoon and deep-drop) in SoCal; occasional central coast. low
_sources.shortfin-mako: Summer peak, SoCal Bight is a mako nursery (NOAA SWFSC juvenile shark survey). low
_sources.blue-shark: Present most of the year offshore; best spring–summer. low
_sources.pacific-bonito: SoCal mostly year-round, best summer–fall; reaches Monterey in warm years. low
_sources.skipjack-tuna: Only in warm summers/falls in SoCal. low
_sources.giant-sea-bass: Occurs in SoCal but take is prohibited in California (14 CCR §28.10) → null so it is never mapped as a target.
_sources.pelagic-thresher: Alopias pelagicus is essentially absent from California sport catches; the California thresher is the common thresher (new species "common-thresher").
_sources.albacore: Offshore, irregular: in the 2020s mostly Aug–Oct off central/northern California, some summers off SoCal. PFMC HMS SAFE. low
_sources.california-barracuda: Spring–summer schools in SoCal (CDFW barracuda species account). low
_sources.rockfish: Available year-round; Jan–Mar boat closure handled by closures; SoCal Oct–Dec nearshore closed (limits text). low
_sources.lingcod: Year-round availability, larger fish shallower in late fall–winter before nesting; Jan–Mar boat closure handled by closures. low
_sources.california-sheephead: SoCal reef species, rare north of Pt Conception (range to Monterey Bay); Jan–Feb boat closure. low
_sources.common-thresher: Spring–early summer coastal run in SoCal (Santa Monica Bay, San Diego), summer in SF Bay/Monterey (Cartamil et al. 2010; NOAA SWFSC). low
_sources._others: All other existing zones.js species are tropical/Gulf of California species not caught (or extremely rare) in California → null.
